content: बकुलः .²1 A kind of tree, Mimusops Elengi, (said according to the convention of poets to put forth blossoms when sprinkled by young women with mouthfuls of wine); काङ्क्षत्यन्यो (केसरः or बकुलः) वदनमादिरां दोहदच्छद्यनाऽस्याः <ls>Me. 80</ls>; बकुलः सीधुगण्डूषसेकात् (विकसति); तव निश्वसितानुकारिर्भिर्बकुलैरर्धचितां समं मया <ls>R. 8. 64</ls>; (for similar conventions about other trees see the quotation under अशोक). .²2 A kind of drug. .{@-लम्@} The fragrant flower of this tree; कृती मालाकारो बकुलमपि कुत्रापि निदधे <ls>Bv. 1. 54</ls>. .{@-ली@} A kind of drug.
